prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: One complete standalone camp blacksmith forge/workshop concept PNG for image-to-3D conversion in Tripo.
Input references: Image 1 is the NEW merchant stall, the PRIMARY source for the chunky hand-painted carved wood, large chamfers, arched timber framing, broad canvas folds, iron corners and oversized rivets. Image 2 is smith Eni, ONLY a CLOTHING COLOUR reference; do not include her or any person. Image 3 is the OLD forge, ONLY a functional smithy reference; redesign its structure, do not copy its broad roof, striped canopy, flag, lights or lighting. Image 4 is the actual game camp, ONLY camera/readability/scale context, never reproduce the scene, UI, ground, plants or characters.

Primary request: Design a NEW compact woodland camp smithy that belongs to the same crafted visual family as the merchant stall, with cloth colours taken from Eni's clothes. One coherent workshop, roughly 4.2 m wide and 2 m deep.
Composition: Square 1:1 image, one full workshop centred with 8–10% empty transparent margin, completely visible. Orthographic three-quarter front view from 48 degrees above horizontal, similar orientation to image 1. Major working surfaces must be clearly visible from this overhead camera.

Structure: A substantial honey-brown timber workbench occupies the left two thirds, with an OPEN front work surface and chunky reinforced legs, an open lower shelf and a shallow stepped rear tool shelf. At the rear of the wooden portion, TWO arched timber supports joined by a beam carry a SHORT SHALLOW CANVAS AWNING, similar in construction to image 1. Its canopy is only about 0.7 m deep and covers the BACK 20–25% of the workshop, leaving the whole front work surface clearly exposed. No front canopy posts, no low hanging valance. On the right side, OUTSIDE the cloth roof footprint, a compact warm grey-brown faceted stone forge with a stout tapered chimney at its rear; chimney height about 2.8 m, not a towering castle. The visible front hearth is dark, unlit, with a few grey coal shapes and a broad stone lip. A stout dark leather bellows fixed to the forge side.
Tools: A large readable iron anvil securely mounted on a low chunky wooden block at the open FRONT LEFT, clearly separated in silhouette from the bench and away from the canopy. One large simple bench vise on the uncovered bench, three thick steel ingots on the lower shelf, one broad hammer and one pair of thick tongs on the worktop, two plain broad unfinished sabre blades resting on the low rear shelf. Few meaningful chunky tool groups, no tiny clutter.

Cloth palette MUST be Eni's clothing: muted brick red / warm burnt TERRACOTTA main canvas matching her apron, restrained warm CREAM edging matching her shirt, a SMALL golden OCHRE stitched reinforcement patch matching her sash. Plain fabric, broad painted folds and a little wear, NO olive or green cloth, NO broad red/white stripes, NO patterned borders, decorative icons or symbols. Wood remains in the same warm honey/ochre family as the merchant stall. Dull dark iron fittings, warm grey stone and understated dark leather, broad hand-painted colour planes.

Style: exactly the reference family: chunky slightly irregular faceted fantasy game prop, generously bevelled corners, broad painted wood-grain strokes, readable large forms, painted stone facets, no photorealistic PBR microtexture, no fine pores/fabric weave, no black cartoon outlines. Neutral diffuse material shading, no cinematic lighting.

Background: TRUE transparent alpha PNG. Only the physical workshop and its attached tools. No opaque backdrop, no checkerboard drawn into pixels, no floor/terrain island, overall plinth, paving, ground, grass, plants, fence, rocks unrelated to the forge or shadow.
Avoid: people, flags, banners, heraldry, emblems, writing, labels, watermark, magical runes, lamps, candles, flames, smoke, sparks, glowing embers, bloom, external glow, cast shadows. Do not let the roof obscure the anvil, vise or worktop.
colour_reference: Одежда Эни: терракотовый фартук, кремовая рубаха, охристый пояс.
notes: Standalone концепт для Tripo. Неглубокий задний навес; горн сбоку; открытая рабочая поверхность; наковальня впереди. Без флагов, геральдики, людей, огня и нарисованного освещения.
